changelog:
- Initial release of kapsel: project memory capsule management for AI agents.
- Archive completed project knowledge as structured folders on Google Drive or any rclone-supported cloud storage.
- Triggered by keywords like "Kapsel", "capsule", "project archive", or requests to store, recall, or manage project knowledge.
- Provides commands to create, load, list, summarize, archive, and add files to project capsules.
- Enables clean agent memory by offloading inactive project details into retrievable capsules.
